capabilities: detect orphan notes with configurable strictness
find broken wikilinks and markdown links
flag empty, oversized, and fuzzy-duplicate notes
report unused tags and unreferenced attachments
fix issues with one-click open or delete actions
extras: Part of a 'Plus Plugin Family' with sibling plugins Paste Plus and Link Plus; fully offline with no telemetry; the fuzzy-duplicate check is recommended off for vaults above ~5,000 notes; the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
motivation: The author built it because vault rot becomes universal after roughly 200 notes and existing solutions are scattered single-purpose plugins.
problem: Obsidian offers no built-in vault health check, so finding orphans, broken links, and duplicate or empty notes requires scattered single-purpose plugins or manual hunting.
summary: Sidebar dashboard that audits vault health, finding orphans, broken links, empty and oversized notes, duplicates, unused tags and unreferenced attachments with one-click fixes.
